title: First Taste of Midtown
blurb:
Discover the vibrant culinary scene of Atlanta on the Global Bites & Sips tour, where three international restaurants showcase their unique flavors. Savor expertly paired drinks and shareable appetizers at each venue, immersing yourself in a world of bold spices and refined techniques. This food tour is designed for adventurous eaters eager to explore the diverse gastronomic offerings of one of Atlanta’s most dynamic neighborhoods.

- Visit three restaurants featuring international cuisines
- Enjoy shareable appetizers and expertly paired drinks
- Perfect for adventurous food lovers and culinary explorers
- Explore the diverse flavors in Atlanta's lively neighborhood
